name: Magic Sensitivity applies its debuff on a Shatter Echo critical strike (#1944)
contract: Magic Sensitivity 520171 applies aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on 520177, a target debuff whose single effect is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER with EffectBasePoints 9 / DieSides 1 (+10%), EffectMiscValue 127 (all schools) and DurationIndex 31 (8000 ms); its empty EffectSpellClassMask makes SpellInfo::IsAffected accept every family 28 spell of that caster, which is the tooltip's "damage taken from you". Spell.dbc gives 520171's record ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so the debuff could never be applied. The fix is a spell_proc row on the ranged class damage of Shatter Echo (family 28, word2 0x10) with HitMask 2 (PROC_HIT_CRITICAL) for the tooltip's "Critical strikes with", at the record's own 100% ProcChance. The critical strike is made deterministic, not the proc chance: Shatter Echo is Spell.dbc DmgClass 3, so Unit::SpellDoneCritChance reads PLAYER_RANGED_CRIT_PERCENTAGE, and Ideal Time 807210 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT, EffectBasePoints 99 / DieSides 1 = +100) is added to that field's flat mod by Player::UpdateWeaponDependentCritAuras, which sums SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT into CRIT_PERCENTAGE, OFFHAND_CRIT_PERCENTAGE and RANGED_CRIT_PERCENTAGE alike with no weapon requirement. The scenario asserts the resulting chance is at least 100 before casting, so the fixture is self-verifying and roll_chance_f cannot fail; the same 807210 fixture is used by the sibling chronomancer-a-ripple-in-time-cooldown.json scenario. Achieved false-failure probability: 0% - a single cast, with both the critical strike and the proc chance pinned at 100%. Shatter Echo carries CasterAuraSpell 804455 (Echo Fragment), fixtured with set_aura, and ranged_hit_rating removes any chance of a miss.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No Magic Sensitivity debuff before any cast
Ideal Time pins the critical strike chance
Echo Fragments satisfy Shatter Echo's CasterAuraSpell
The fixture really does guarantee a critical strike
A critical Shatter Echo applies Magic Sensitivity
